221	def rearm_keep(net, stop, sess_first, sess_run, k, L):
222	    """Re-arm after a winner: while armed, take and count (stops, net since the last arm); stop when the count reaches >= k stops
223	    or <= L; while stopped, skip, and re-arm at the next SETUP (counters reset) when the skipped SETUP's paper trade wins."""
224	    n = len(net); keep = np.zeros(n, dtype=bool)
225	    for s in range(len(sess_first)):
226	        a = sess_first[s]; b = sess_first[s + 1] if s + 1 < len(sess_first) else n
227	        armed, ns, nn = True, 0, 0.0
228	        for j in range(a, b):
229	            if armed:
230	                keep[j] = True; ns += int(stop[j]); nn += net[j]
231	                if ns >= k or (L is not None and nn <= L): armed = False
232	            else:
233	                keep[j] = False
234	                if net[j] > 0: armed, ns, nn = True, 0, 0.0
235	    return keep

27	
28	## Judges' verdicts
29	
30	### Judge 1
31	
32	Skeptical-practitioner verdict. The tape sets the ceiling before any model runs: 1m Foundation is +1.9 pts per trade gross against ~16 pts of cost (mean net -922 INR, 15.2% winners, 4,502 IS SETUPs in 579 active sessions); 5m is 184 IS winners with the top decile carrying ~46% of gross and an IS-to-OOS mean shift from -277 to -1,060 per trade. So any gate must find a subset whose expectancy clears ~16-20 pts, and the whole signal lives in a few hundred trades on 1m and a few dozen on 5m. On that sample the block-bootstrap CI of a kept-vs-skipped difference will be several hundred INR per trade wide; most candidates will not clear it, and that is the honest expected outcome. Every library the 18 studies name is present (sklearn 1.7.2 with interaction_cst/monotonic_cst, numba 0.65, xgboost 3.2.0, shap 0.49.1, pyarrow, scipy, matplotlib) and statsmodels/torch/mapie are absent as assumed; feasibility failures are compute and memory, not imports.
33	
34	Keep seven, merged into five lines of work, about 1-1.5 CPU-hours per timeframe in total: (1) one validation harness = quant-ml-canon-purged-cpcv-pbo with decision-making-3's SPA, adversarial drift and 5m null tapes folded in (one ledger, one bootstrap, one PBO, active sessions only, every comparator re-priced on the L1 15:25 label); (2) one feature-vocabulary pass = quant-ml-canon-feature-importance, its 8-cluster shortlist frozen in the ledger before any gate search, with BOCPD, FFD and the novelty scalars entering there and nowhere else; (3) one learned-gate family = quant-ml-canon-meta-label-gate and decision-making-1 merged (L1 label, capped |net| weights, top-1%-winners-removed as a hard pass, block-wise sign test, one distilled rule list or scorecard as the single OOS candidate from the family); (4) the interpretable candidate = deep-sequence-llm-hypotheses with a blind round 0 from the user's words alone, hashed before any table is shown, and cross-fitted round-1 tables; (5) the cheap desk rule = decision-making-6 session stop with an hour-conditioned null. That yields at most three OOS looks: the rule list from (3), the round-0 list from (4), and the frozen ST7/ST8 gate as comparator, with (5) as a multiplication if its null is rejected.
35	
36	Drop or defer eleven. The sequence and representation studies (rocket, pretrain, HMM/jump, motif/shapelet, vision) share one structural flaw: the only shippable form is a depth-3 tree on the same scalar features the tabular studies already search, so they add trials to the ledger without adding a candidate, and the pre-SETUP window is templated by the engine's own SETUP definition; pretrain and 1m FQI also need 750-900 MB for hours on a box shared with another build. The two conformal studies and the two sizing studies do not change which SETUPs are taken: they choose a threshold on a score another study produces, or size a positive edge that does not yet exist; their useful pieces (slippage 3/5/8 sensitivity, Pareto front with user-chosen w, |net|-weighted coverage, one-lot-or-skip verdict) become sections of the gate study's deliverable. The regime-breaks study keeps only its break tests as the harness's pre-registration step (they decide time-decay weights and the OOS caveat); BSADF is a feature candidate for the importance pass, not a gate. The exit study is worth its parametric learner C (config keys the lab already has, 10 minutes by replay) but must be coordinated with the ST9-12 session, which already ran an exit grid on 2026.
37	
38	Two standing caveats every OOS table must carry: the OOS window (2026-01-01..09-25) is also the published lab dashboard window and was used by the ST9-12 exit grid, so it is not pristine; and the 5m Foundation label as built holds 358 of 1,012 trades past the entry session, so ST13/ST14 (square_off 15:25) must be judged on the recomputed intraday label and every comparator re-priced on it.
39

430	**novelty.** Kelly 1956 and Thorp 2006 (growth-optimal sizing); MacLean, Thorp & Ziemba 2010 (fractional Kelly and its risk-growth trade-off); Busseti, Ryu & Boyd 2016 (risk-constrained Kelly gambling with a drawdown constraint as a convex problem); Baker & McHale 2013 (Kelly under parameter uncertainty, shrinkage). Sizing is treated as a policy downstream of a calibrated bandit value, not as a standalone optimisation, which is what keeps it from amplifying an overfit gate.
431	
432	**Judge 1** feasible 5 · rigour 3 · expected value 1 · keep False — fix: Trap: quantile regression of net on ~180 winners; Kelly on a book whose raw edge is negative returns 0 lots by construction, which the study already states; duplicate of study 5. Fix: do not run until a gate has passed OOS; then the one-table version of study 5 with charges per lot held at the 1-lot rate.
433	
434	**Judge 2** feasible 5 · rigour 4 · expected value 2 · keep False — fix: Duplicate of quant-ml-canon-bet-sizing on a book whose gated edge is not yet shown positive (raw Kelly is negative at 15-22% win rate). Merge the two into one conditional sizing step that runs only after a gate passes the harness go/no-go; ship the monotone <= 3-step lots schedule only if a bucket has CPCV 5th-percentile net-per-lot improvement > 0, else record 'lots = 1 or skip'. Per-signal lots is a lab change: ask the user before any key is written.
435	
436	### decision-making-6-session-stop-rule-finite-horizon (priority 6)
437	
438	**technique.** Session-level stopping rule as a finite-horizon MDP with exact replay: stop trading for the day after k stop-outs or a loss L, tested against the null that the session ledger so far carries no information about the next SETUP
439	
440	**what_it_answers.** Whether the causal session ledger (today_net_asof, today_n_stops_asof, today_n_setups_before; 1m median 8 SETUPs per active session, max 20) predicts the next SETUP's net at all, and whether a daily stop rule adds expectancy beyond the cost it saves by trading less (the pure cost-avoidance trap in its simplest form).
441	
442	**method.** State at each SETUP: (today_n_stops_asof, today_net_asof bucket, today_n_setups_before, hour_bin) plus the study-1 score. Null test first: permutation of SETUP order within each session (2,000 draws) for the correlation between today_net_asof and the next fnd_net and for the difference in mean net after >= k stops vs fewer; if the null is not rejected on IS the study ends with "no session memory" and no key. If rejected: finite-horizon DP by exact replay over the small grid k in {1,2,3,4}, L in {-2,000, -4,000, -6,000, none} INR, optional re-arm after a winner; value = kept-minus-skipped expectancy (never net), session-matched random control at the same per-session k (this rule is a within-session gate, so the standard control applies directly), permutation p. Combined with the study-1 gate as a multiplication (gate AND not-stopped) and reported both alone and combined. OOS once with the frozen (k, L).
443	
444	**leakage_controls.** The ledger fields use only trades with exit <= k (as built; verified by the truncation diff); the grid is fixed above (16 cells, counted in study 3's multiplicity set); CV by contiguous session blocks with the 2-session embargo; the null test is pre-registered as the entry condition; OOS once.
445	
446	**compute.** < 3 CPU-min, < 200 MB (numpy replay over <= 5k rows x 16 cells x 2,000 permutations).
447	
448	**libraries.** numpy, pandas, scipy.stats
449	
450	**output_as_config.** strategy_13/14.json "session_stop": {"max_stops_today": k, "max_loss_today_inr": L, "rearm_after_win": false} with provenance, or nothing when the null is not rejected (recorded in S49 as measured).
451	
452	**novelty.** A finite-horizon optimal-stopping formulation of a trading-desk rule (daily loss limit), evaluated the way the sequential studies are: exact replay, a pre-registered null that the ledger is uninformative (a within-session permutation test), and the same cost-avoidance-aware yardsticks. Cheap and self-terminating; it exists mainly because the ledger features are already causal in the table and a naive fit would otherwise 'discover' a stop rule that is pure cost avoidance.
453	
454	**Judge 1** feasible 5 · rigour 4 · expected value 3 · keep True — fix: Trap: permuting SETUP order within a session also destroys the hour-of-day link (today_net_asof grows with the clock and the hour profile is known), so a rejected null may be the hour effect, not session memory; and a stop rule always trades less, so cost avoidance masquerades as skill unless judged at matched per-session k. Fix: permute within session x hour bin (or partial out hour_bin first) as the pre-registered null; run on 1m as the primary (median 8 SETUPs per active session; on 5m most active sessions carry one or two SETUPs so the rule rarely binds); count the 16 cells in the harness ledger; judge only by kept-vs-skipped at matched k and the session-matched control; the config is two numbers and the study self-terminates on a null.
455	
456	**Judge 2** feasible 5 · rigour 5 · expected value 3 · keep True — fix: Run as written (it is the cleanest pre-registered test in the set); count its 16 cells in the shared ledger. Report 5m as underpowered (few SETUPs per session) and treat it as a 1m study. Test the 'rearm after a winner' and hour interaction only if the within-session permutation null is rejected, and score the combined (gate AND not-stopped) form through the harness so it does not become a fourth OOS candidate.
457

211	    `draws` times with random.Random(f"{seed}|{tag}|perm"), +1 corrected). kept = Foundation's trades on the SETUPs FZ held
212	    a position on (a TAKE, or a REENTER on that SETUP, on its own bar or later), blocked = Foundation's other trades: the
213	    split is by what FZ traded, not by the gate as of the SETUP bar."""
214	    out = dict(kept_n=len(kept), blocked_n=len(blocked), kept_mean=rnd(statistics.mean(kept)) if kept else None,

216	    if not kept or not blocked: return out

218	    pooled, nk = list(kept) + list(blocked), len(kept)
219	    rng, hits = random.Random(f"{seed}|{tag}|perm"), 0
220	    for _ in range(draws):
221	        rng.shuffle(pooled)
222	        d = sum(pooled[:nk]) / nk - sum(pooled[nk:]) / (len(pooled) - nk)
223	        hits += abs(d) >= abs(obs) - 1e-9

                sess_multi_last_win_rate=m(win[multi_s & last_s]), sess_multi_nonlast_win_rate=m(win[multi_s & ~last_s]))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- cells on any frame
def cell_keep(cfg, St, runmin):
    k, L = cfg["max_stops_today"], cfg["max_loss_today_inr"]
    if cfg.get("rearm_after_win"): m = SS.rearm_keep(St["net"], St["stop"], St["sess_first"], St["sess_run"], k, L)
    else: m = SS.grid_keep(St["today_stops"], runmin, k, L)
    if cfg.get("active_from_hour_bin") is not None: m = m | (St["hbc"] < HB_CODE[cfg["active_from_hour_bin"]])
    return m


def cell_stats(St, cells):
    runmin = SS.running_min_by_session(St["today_net"], St["sess_first"], St["sess_run"])
    pooled, strat, share = np.full(len(cells), np.nan), np.full(len(cells), np.nan), np.full(len(cells), np.nan)
    for i, c in enumerate(cells):
        m = cell_keep(c, St, runmin); share[i] = m.mean()
        if m.any() and (~m).any():
            pooled[i] = St["net"][m].mean() - St["net"][~m].mean(); strat[i] = strat_diff(St["hbc"], m, St["net"])
    return pooled, strat, share


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- N1 as in session_stop.null_test, on any frame, with an explicit rng
def n1_on_frame(St, rng, draws):
    cell = St["cell_run"]; obs = SS.stats7(St["today_net"], St["today_stops"], St["net"])
    perm_stats = np.empty((draws, 7))
    for d in range(draws):
        perm = np.lexsort((rng.random(len(cell)), cell))
        pn, ps = St["net"][perm], St["stop"][perm]
        tn, ts = SS.recompute_ledger(pn, ps, St["sess_first"], St["sess_run"])
        perm_stats[d] = SS.stats7(tn, ts, pn)
    p, lo, hi, pct, n = tail_p(obs, perm_stats)
    return dict(observed=obs, p=p, p_holm=holm(p), perm_mean=np.nanmean(perm_stats, axis=0), excess=obs - np.nanmean(perm_stats, axis=0))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- parallel jobs over memoryless streams
def sim_batch(G, seeds, tied, cells):
    out = []
    for sd in seeds:
        St = simulate(G, int(sd), tied)
        pooled, strat, share = cell_stats(St, cells)
        out.append(dict(seed=int(sd), n=int(len(St["net"])), sessions=int(len(St["sess_first"])), stats7=SS.stats7(St["today_net"], St["today_stops"], St["net"]),
                        strat7=strat7(St["hbc"], St["today_net"], St["today_stops"], St["net"]), strat7_fine=strat7(St["fine"], St["today_net"], St["today_stops"], St["net"]),
                        mech=mechanism(St), pooled=pooled, strat=strat, share=share))
    return out


def demo_batch(G, seeds, tied, tf, n1_draws, control_draws):
    out = []
    for sd in seeds:
        St = simulate(G, int(sd), tied)
        R = n1_on_frame(St, np.random.default_rng(int(sd) ^ 0x5bd1e995), n1_draws)
        runmin = SS.running_min_by_session(St["today_net"], St["sess_first"], St["sess_run"])
        m = SS.grid_keep(St["today_stops"], runmin, 2, None)
        raw = [dict(day=str(int(s)), net=float(v)) for s, v in zip(St["sess"], St["net"])]; sel = [u for u, k in zip(raw, m) if k]
        rc = fz_report.random_control(raw, sel, control_draws, H.SEED, f"{STUDY}|repair|{tf}|demo|{'tied' if tied else 'indep'}|{int(sd)}")
        mech = mechanism(St)
        out.append(dict(seed=int(sd), tied=bool(tied), n=int(len(St["net"])), min_p_holm=float(np.nanmin(R["p_holm"])), rejected=bool(np.nanmin(R["p_holm"]) < CFG["alpha"]),
                        observed=R["observed"], excess=R["excess"], p_holm=R["p_holm"], k2_kept_share=float(m.mean()),
                        k2_pooled_diff=float(St["net"][m].mean() - St["net"][~m].mean()) if m.any() and (~m).any() else float("nan"),
                        k2_strat_diff=strat_diff(St["hbc"], m, St["net"]) if m.any() and (~m).any() else float("nan"),
                        k2_control_pct=rc["fz_pct"], k2_control_p_beat=rc["p_beat"],
                        cell_multi_last_win_rate=mech["cell_multi_last_win_rate"], cell_multi_nonlast_win_rate=mech["cell_multi_nonlast_win_rate"]))
    return out


def run_parallel(fn, G, seeds, per_task, *args):
    batches = [seeds[i:i + per_task] for i in range(0, len(seeds), per_task)]
    res = Parallel(n_jobs=CFG["n_jobs"], backend="loky")(delayed(fn)(G, b, *args) for b in batches)
    return [r for batch in res for r in batch]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- N4 on the real book
def session_units(St):
    S_ = np.array(sorted(set(St["sess"].tolist()))); return S_, [np.flatnonzero(St["sess"] == s) for s in S_]


def boot_rows(St, tag, draws):
    S_, units = session_units(St)
    idx = H.stationary_bootstrap_idx(len(S_), draws, tag=tag)
    return [np.concatenate([units[i] for i in idx[d]]) for d in range(draws)]


def n4_bootstrap(St, strata_key, tag, draws):
    strata = St[strata_key]
    obs = strat7(strata, St["today_net"], St["today_stops"], St["net"])
    boot = np.empty((draws, 7))
    for d, r in enumerate(boot_rows(St, tag, draws)):
        boot[d] = strat7(strata[r], St["today_net"][r], St["today_stops"][r], St["net"][r])
    p, lo, hi, pct, n = tail_p(np.zeros(7), boot)
    p = np.where(np.isfinite(obs), p, np.nan)
    q = lambda a: np.nanquantile(boot, a, axis=0)
    return dict(observed=obs, boot_mean=np.nanmean(boot, axis=0), boot_sd=np.nanstd(boot, axis=0), ci90=[q(0.05), q(0.95)], ci95=[q(0.025), q(0.975)],
                p=p, p_holm=holm(p), p_le0=lo, p_ge0=hi, n_valid=n, draws=draws, strata=int(strata.max()) + 1)


def n_condition(St):
    out = [len(St["net"])]
    for k in K_TESTS: out.append(int((St["today_stops"] >= k).sum()))
    for L in L_TESTS: out.append(int((St["today_net"] <= L).sum()))
    return out


def null_tables(St, sims, n4, n4_fine, tf, label):
    """The repaired null-test table for one (tf, label): N3 (simulation) and N4 (stratified bootstrap) per test."""
    obs7 = SS.stats7(St["today_net"], St["today_stops"], St["net"])
    sim7 = np.array([s["stats7"] for s in sims]); simS = np.array([s["strat7"] for s in sims]); simF = np.array([s["strat7_fine"] for s in sims])
    p3, lo3, hi3, pct3, n3 = tail_p(obs7, sim7); ph3 = holm(p3)
    p4s, _, _, pct4s, _ = tail_p(n4["observed"], simS)            # the N4 statistic against its memoryless distribution (centring check)
    p4f, _, _, pct4f, _ = tail_p(n4_fine["observed"], simF)
    ncond = n_condition(St)
    rows = []
    for j, t in enumerate(TESTS):
        rows.append(dict(tf=tf, label=label, test=t, n_condition=ncond[j], observed=round(float(obs7[j]), 4),
                         N3_sim_mean=round(float(np.nanmean(sim7[:, j])), 4), N3_sim_sd=round(float(np.nanstd(sim7[:, j])), 4), N3_excess=round(float(obs7[j] - np.nanmean(sim7[:, j])), 4),
                         N3_pct=round(float(pct3[j]), 2), N3_p=round(float(p3[j]), 4), N3_p_holm=round(float(ph3[j]), 4), N3_valid=int(n3[j]),
                         N4_stat=round(float(n4["observed"][j]), 4), N4_boot_sd=round(float(n4["boot_sd"][j]), 4), N4_ci90_lo=round(float(n4["ci90"][0][j]), 4), N4_ci90_hi=round(float(n4["ci90"][1][j]), 4),
                         N4_ci95_lo=round(float(n4["ci95"][0][j]), 4), N4_ci95_hi=round(float(n4["ci95"][1][j]), 4), N4_p=round(float(n4["p"][j]), 4), N4_p_holm=round(float(n4["p_holm"][j]), 4),
                         N4_sim_mean=round(float(np.nanmean(simS[:, j])), 4), N4_sim_sd=round(float(np.nanstd(simS[:, j])), 4), N4_sim_pct=round(float(pct4s[j]), 2), N4_sim_p=round(float(p4s[j]), 4),
                         N4fine_stat=round(float(n4_fine["observed"][j]), 4), N4fine_p=round(float(n4_fine["p"][j]), 4), N4fine_p_holm=round(float(n4_fine["p_holm"][j]), 4),
                         N4fine_sim_mean=round(float(np.nanmean(simF[:, j])), 4), N4fine_sim_p=round(float(p4f[j]), 4)))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows), dict(min_p_holm_N3=float(np.nanmin(ph3)), min_p_holm_N4=float(np.nanmin(n4["p_holm"])), rejected_N3=bool(np.nanmin(ph3) < CFG["alpha"]),
                                    rejected_N4=bool(np.nanmin(n4["p_holm"]) < CFG["alpha"]), min_p_holm_N4fine=float(np.nanmin(n4_fine["p_holm"])),
                                    signs_agree=bool(all(np.sign(obs7[j] - np.nanmean(sim7[:, j])) == np.sign(n4["observed"][j]) for j in range(7)
                                                         if ph3[j] < CFG["alpha"] and n4["p_holm"][j] < CFG["alpha"])))


def decide(d):
    if d["rejected_N3"] and d["rejected_N4"] and d["signs_agree"]: return "MEMORY CLAIMED: N3 and N4 both reject (Holm 5%) with agreeing signs -> session memory beyond the hour effect"
    if d["rejected_N3"] != d["rejected_N4"] or (d["rejected_N3"] and d["rejected_N4"]): return "INCONCLUSIVE: exactly one hindsight-free null rejects (or signs disagree) -> not shown, no key"
    return "NOT REJECTED under N3 or N4 -> no session memory shown beyond the hour effect, no key"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- branch B repair (the 48-cell family, hindsight-free judgement)
def choose_key(T, masks, tr):
    best = SS.choose_cell(T, masks, tr)
    return best[2] if best is not None else None


def branch_b_repair(T, tf, St, sims, out, dev):
    log(f"[{tf}] branch B repair: 16 hour-conditioned cells (active_from_hour_bin={ACTIVE_FROM}), nested / CPCV over the 48-cell family, hindsight-free judgement")
    is_rows = np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask)
    masks32 = SS.cell_masks(T)
    runmin = SS.running_min_by_session(St["today_net"], St["sess_first"], St["sess_run"])
    masks = {}
    for c in CELLS48:
        m = cell_keep(c, St, runmin); full = np.ones(T.n, dtype=bool); full[is_rows] = m; masks[key_of(c)] = full
    for c in CELLS48[:32]: assert (masks32[key_of(c)] == masks[key_of(c)]).all(), "the 32 as-run masks must reproduce"
    fam = f"{STUDY}/grid"
    led = {}
    for r in H.read_ledger(fam, tf=tf, label="L1"):
        if r["family"] == fam: led.setdefault(key_of(r["config"]), r)                    # the first (as-run) row per config
    grid_rows = []
    for c in CELLS48:
        k = key_of(c)
        if k in led: r = dict(led[k], source="ledger (as run)" if led[k].get("note") != "repair" else "ledger (repair)")
        elif dev: r = dict(H.metrics(T, masks[k], is_rows, tag="dev", controls=False), id="dev", config=c, source="dev (no ledger row)")
        else: r = dict(H.score(T, masks[k], fam, c, script=__file__, note="repair"), source="repair")
        grid_rows.append(r)
        log(f"  cell {c}: id {r['id']} kept {r['kept_n']} share {r['kept_share']} diff {r['diff']} top1off {r['diff_top1_removed']} ctrl {r.get('control_pct')} [{r['source']}]")
    # nested choice inside the 12 purged folds, the 66 CPCV splits -> 11 paths (criterion unchanged: max pooled diff | kept_share >= 0.20)
    oof = np.zeros(T.n, dtype=bool); chosen = []
    for b, (tr, te) in enumerate(H.purged_splits(T)):
        k = choose_key(T, masks, tr); chosen.append(json.loads(k) if k else None)
        oof[te] = masks[k][te] if k else True
    sel_cfg = dict(selection="max diff | kept_share>=0.20 in training fold", folds=12, cells=48, family="grid as run + active_from_hour_bin=13")
    nested = H.score(T, oof, f"{STUDY}/nested", sel_cfg, script=__file__, note="repair") if not dev else dict(H.metrics(T, oof, is_rows, tag="dev", controls=False), id="dev")
    log(f"  nested OOF (48 cells): id {nested['id']} kept {nested['kept_n']} share {nested['kept_share']} diff {nested['diff']} top1off {nested['diff_top1_removed']} perm_p {nested.get('perm_p')} ctrl {nested.get('control_pct')} sign_blocks {nested['sign_blocks']}")
    oof_split = {}
    for tr, te, (a, b) in H.cpcv_splits(T):
        k = choose_key(T, masks, tr); oof_split[(a, b)] = (masks[k][te] if k else np.ones(len(te), dtype=bool)).astype(float)
    paths = H.cpcv_paths(T, oof_split)
    path_rows = []
    for p, arr in enumerate(paths):                                  # = harness.score_paths, with note="repair" on every row
        keep = np.asarray(arr).astype(bool)
        pcfg = dict(selection=sel_cfg["selection"], cells=48, path=p)
        path_rows.append(H.score(T, keep, f"{STUDY}/nested/cpcv", pcfg, script=__file__, controls=True, note="repair") if not dev
                         else dict(H.metrics(T, keep, is_rows, tag="dev", controls=False), id="dev", control_pct=None))
    dd = np.array([x["diff"] if x["diff"] is not None else np.nan for x in path_rows], dtype=float)
    cc = np.array([x["control_pct"] if x.get("control_pct") is not None else np.nan for x in path_rows], dtype=float)
    dist = dict(paths=len(path_rows), diff_median=round(float(np.nanmedian(dd)), 2), diff_p5=round(float(np.nanquantile(dd, 0.05)), 2), diff_min=round(float(np.nanmin(dd)), 2),
                diff_share_positive=round(float((dd > 0).mean()), 3), kept_share_median=round(float(np.median([x["kept_share"] for x in path_rows])), 4),
                diff_top1_removed_median=round(float(np.nanmedian([x["diff_top1_removed"] if x["diff_top1_removed"] is not None else np.nan for x in path_rows])), 2),
                control_pct_median=round(float(np.nanmedian(cc)), 1) if np.isfinite(cc).any() else None, control_pct_p5=round(float(np.nanquantile(cc, 0.05)), 1) if np.isfinite(cc).any() else None)
    log(f"  CPCV (48 cells): {dist}")
    # family statistics over the 48, the cell chosen on all IS, DSR, bootstrap, go / no-go with and without the control check
    vecs = [H.session_vectors(T, masks[key_of(c)], is_rows) for c in CELLS48]
    fam_stats = dict(cells=48, pbo_diff=H.pbo(vecs, "diff"), pbo_kept_mean=H.pbo(vecs, "kept_mean"), spa=H.spa(vecs, tag=f"{STUDY}|repair|{tf}"), effective_trials=H.effective_trials(vecs))
    kbest = choose_key(T, masks, is_rows); cand = json.loads(kbest) if kbest else None
    res = next((r for r, c in zip(grid_rows, CELLS48) if key_of(c) == kbest), None)
    go = None
    if res is not None:
        vec = vecs[[key_of(c) for c in CELLS48].index(kbest)]
        per = np.where(vec["kept_n"] > 0, vec["kept_sum"] / np.maximum(vec["kept_n"], 1), 0.0)[vec["kept_n"] > 0]
        srs = []
        for v in vecs:
            x = np.where(v["kept_n"] > 0, v["kept_sum"] / np.maximum(v["kept_n"], 1), 0.0)[v["kept_n"] > 0]
            if len(x) > 2 and x.std(ddof=1) > 0: srs.append(x.mean() / x.std(ddof=1))
        sr_var = float(np.var(srs, ddof=1)) if len(srs) > 1 and np.var(srs, ddof=1) > 0 else None
        dsr = H.deflated_sharpe(per, len(vecs), sr_var); boot = H.bootstrap_ci(vec, tag=f"{STUDY}|repair|{tf}")
        passed, checks = H.go_no_go(res, tf, cpcv=dist, pbo_value=fam_stats["pbo_diff"]["pbo"], dsr=dsr, spa_p=fam_stats["spa"]["spa_p"], boot=boot)
        wo = {k: v for k, v in checks.items() if k != "control_pct>=95"}
        go = dict(candidate=cand, candidate_ledger_id=res["id"], candidate_source=res["source"], dsr=dsr, bootstrap=boot, passed=passed, checks=checks,
                  passed_without_control_check=all(v[0] for v in wo.values()), failing_without_control_check=[k for k, v in wo.items() if not v[0]])
        log(f"  chosen on all IS: {cand} -> go={passed}; without the control check: {go['passed_without_control_check']} (failing: {go['failing_without_control_check']})")
        comb_cfg = dict(cand, and_gate="fz_traded (frozen ST7/ST8, comparator)")
        ex = [r for r in H.read_ledger(f"{STUDY}/combined", tf=tf, label="L1") if r["family"] == f"{STUDY}/combined" and key_of(r["config"]) == key_of(comb_cfg)]
        if ex: comb = dict(ex[0], source="ledger (as run)")
        elif dev: comb = dict(H.metrics(T, masks[kbest] & T.F.fz_traded.astype(bool).to_numpy(), is_rows, tag="dev", controls=False), id="dev", source="dev")
        else: comb = dict(H.score(T, masks[kbest] & T.F.fz_traded.astype(bool).to_numpy(), f"{STUDY}/combined", comb_cfg, script=__file__, note="repair"), source="repair")
        go["combined"] = {k: comb.get(k) for k in ("id", "kept_n", "kept_share", "diff", "diff_top1_removed", "perm_p", "control_pct", "sign_blocks", "source")}
        log(f"  combined (chosen AND fz_traded): {go['combined']}")
    # calibration of every cell against the memoryless generator + the within-hour kept-vs-skipped contrast with the session-block bootstrap
    sim_pooled = np.array([s["pooled"] for s in sims]); sim_strat = np.array([s["strat"] for s in sims]); sim_share = np.array([s["share"] for s in sims])
    obs_pooled = np.array([r["diff"] if r["diff"] is not None else np.nan for r in grid_rows], dtype=float)
    p_pool, _, _, pct_pool, _ = tail_p(obs_pooled, sim_pooled)
    R = boot_rows(St, f"{STUDY}|repair|{tf}|gridstrat", CFG["n_boot"])
    obs_strat = np.full(48, np.nan); boot_strat = np.full((len(R), 48), np.nan)
    hb, net = St["hbc"], St["net"]
    for i, c in enumerate(CELLS48):
        m = masks[key_of(c)][is_rows]
        if m.any() and (~m).any():
            obs_strat[i] = strat_diff(hb, m, net)
            for d, r in enumerate(R): boot_strat[d, i] = strat_diff(hb[r], m[r], net[r])
    p_strat, _, _, _, _ = tail_p(np.zeros(48), boot_strat); p_strat = np.where(np.isfinite(obs_strat), p_strat, np.nan)
    p_strat_sim, _, _, pct_strat_sim, _ = tail_p(obs_strat, sim_strat)
    cal = []
    for i, (c, r) in enumerate(zip(CELLS48, grid_rows)):
        cal.append(dict(cell=i, max_stops_today=c["max_stops_today"], max_loss_today_inr=c["max_loss_today_inr"], rearm_after_win=c["rearm_after_win"],
                        active_from_hour_bin=c.get("active_from_hour_bin"), ledger_id=r["id"], source=r["source"], kept_n=r["kept_n"], kept_share=r["kept_share"],
                        pooled_diff=r["diff"], diff_top1_removed=r["diff_top1_removed"], control_pct=r.get("control_pct"), sign_blocks=r["sign_blocks"],
                        sim_kept_share_mean=round(float(np.nanmean(sim_share[:, i])), 4), sim_pooled_mean=round(float(np.nanmean(sim_pooled[:, i])), 2),
                        sim_pooled_sd=round(float(np.nanstd(sim_pooled[:, i])), 2), pooled_sim_pct=round(float(pct_pool[i]), 2), pooled_sim_p=round(float(p_pool[i]), 4),
                        strat_diff=round(float(obs_strat[i]), 2) if np.isfinite(obs_strat[i]) else None,
                        strat_ci90_lo=round(float(np.nanquantile(boot_strat[:, i], 0.05)), 2) if np.isfinite(boot_strat[:, i]).any() else None,
                        strat_ci90_hi=round(float(np.nanquantile(boot_strat[:, i], 0.95)), 2) if np.isfinite(boot_strat[:, i]).any() else None,
                        strat_boot_p=round(float(p_strat[i]), 4) if np.isfinite(p_strat[i]) else None,
                        sim_strat_mean=round(float(np.nanmean(sim_strat[:, i])), 2), sim_strat_sd=round(float(np.nanstd(sim_strat[:, i])), 2),
                        strat_sim_pct=round(float(pct_strat_sim[i]), 2), strat_sim_p=round(float(p_strat_sim[i]), 4)))
    cal = pd.DataFrame(cal); cal.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTDIR, f"repair_grid_calibration_{tf}.csv"), index=False)
    log(cal[["max_stops_today", "max_loss_today_inr", "rearm_after_win", "active_from_hour_bin", "kept_share", "pooled_diff", "sim_pooled_mean", "sim_pooled_sd", "pooled_sim_pct", "strat_diff", "strat_ci90_lo", "strat_ci90_hi", "strat_boot_p", "sim_strat_mean", "control_pct"]].to_string(index=False))
    pd.DataFrame(grid_rows).to_csv(os.path.join(OUTDIR, f"grid_hour_{tf}.csv"), index=False)
    keep_keys = ("id", "config", "source", "kept_n", "kept_share", "kept_mean", "skipped_mean", "diff", "diff_top1_removed", "perm_p", "control_pct", "loser_recall", "loser_precision",
                 "winner_recall_weighted", "top_decile_winners_skipped", "sign_blocks", "kept_mean_slip8")
    out["branch_b_repair"] = dict(cells=48, active_from_hour_bin=ACTIVE_FROM, grid=[{k: r.get(k) for k in keep_keys} for r in grid_rows],
                                  hour_cells_ledger_ids=[r["id"] for r in grid_rows[32:]],
                                  nested_oof={k: nested.get(k) for k in ("id", "kept_n", "kept_share", "diff", "diff_top1_removed", "perm_p", "control_pct", "sign_blocks")},
                                  chosen_per_fold=chosen, cpcv=dist, cpcv_path_ids=[r["id"] for r in path_rows], family=fam_stats, go_no_go=go,
                                  calibration=cal.to_dict(orient="records"))
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- one timeframe
def run_tf(tf, dev):
    out = dict(tf=tf, primary=tf == "minute")

def hbin(hhmm): return "<09:25" if hhmm < "09:25" else ">=15:20" if hhmm >= "15:20" else hhmm[:2]


def fine_code(hhmm): return int(hhmm[:2]) * 2 + (1 if int(hhmm[3:5]) >= 30 else 0)


def tail_p(obs, dist):
    """Doubled-tail p of obs (vector) against dist (draws x tests), +1 corrected; also the two tails and obs's percentile."""
    obs = np.asarray(obs, dtype=float); dist = np.asarray(dist, dtype=float)
    valid = np.isfinite(dist) & np.isfinite(obs)[None, :]; n = valid.sum(axis=0)
    with np.errstate(invalid="ignore"):
        lo = (1 + ((dist <= obs[None, :] + 1e-12) & valid).sum(axis=0)) / (1 + n)
        hi = (1 + ((dist >= obs[None, :] - 1e-12) & valid).sum(axis=0)) / (1 + n)
        pct = 100.0 * (((dist < obs[None, :] - 1e-12) & valid).sum(axis=0) + 0.5 * ((np.abs(dist - obs[None, :]) <= 1e-12) & valid).sum(axis=0)) / np.maximum(n, 1)
    p = np.minimum(1.0, 2 * np.minimum(lo, hi))
    p = np.where(np.isfinite(obs) & (n > 0), p, np.nan)
    return p, lo, hi, pct, n


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the stratified (hindsight-free) statistics
def strat_diff(strata, cond, net):
    """OLS coefficient of net on cond with stratum fixed effects = sum_h w_h (m_a,h - m_b,h) / sum_h w_h, w_h = n_a n_b / (n_a + n_b)."""
    cond = np.asarray(cond, dtype=bool); ns = int(strata.max()) + 1
    na = np.bincount(strata, weights=cond.astype(float), minlength=ns); nb = np.bincount(strata, minlength=ns) - na
    sa = np.bincount(strata, weights=net * cond, minlength=ns); sb = np.bincount(strata, weights=net * (~cond), minlength=ns)
    ok = (na > 0) & (nb > 0)
    if not ok.any(): return np.nan
    w = na[ok] * nb[ok] / (na[ok] + nb[ok])
    return float(np.sum(w * (sa[ok] / na[ok] - sb[ok] / nb[ok])) / w.sum())


def partial_spearman(strata, x, y):
    """Pearson correlation of the within-stratum demeaned ranks of x and y (ranks over the whole sample)."""
    rx, ry = sst.rankdata(x), sst.rankdata(y); ns = int(strata.max()) + 1
    cnt = np.maximum(np.bincount(strata, minlength=ns), 1)
    rx = rx - (np.bincount(strata, weights=rx, minlength=ns) / cnt)[strata]
    ry = ry - (np.bincount(strata, weights=ry, minlength=ns) / cnt)[strata]
    if rx.std() == 0 or ry.std() == 0: return np.nan
    return float(np.corrcoef(rx, ry)[0, 1])


def strat7(strata, today_net, today_stops, net):
    out = np.full(7, np.nan)
    out[0] = partial_spearman(strata, today_net, net)
    for j, k in enumerate(K_TESTS): out[1 + j] = strat_diff(strata, today_stops >= k, net)
    for j, L in enumerate(L_TESTS): out[4 + j] = strat_diff(strata, today_net <= L, net)
    return out


def holm(p):
    p = np.asarray(p, dtype=float); m = int(np.isfinite(p).sum()); adj = np.full(len(p), np.nan)
    order = [i for i in np.argsort(np.where(np.isfinite(p), p, np.inf)) if np.isfinite(p[i])]; run = 0.0
    for rank, i in enumerate(order):
        run = max(run, min(1.0, (m - rank) * p[i])); adj[i] = run
    return adj


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- frames: the real book and the memoryless streams
def stream_frame(sess, hbc, net, stop, dur, fine=None):
    """A unit sequence (time-ordered, sessions contiguous) as the arrays the statistics read; the ledger recomputed causally."""
    new_sess = np.r_[True, sess[1:] != sess[:-1]]; sess_run = np.cumsum(new_sess) - 1
    new_cell = new_sess | np.r_[True, hbc[1:] != hbc[:-1]]; cell_run = np.cumsum(new_cell) - 1
    sess_first = np.flatnonzero(new_sess)
    tn, ts = SS.recompute_ledger(net, stop, sess_first, sess_run)
    return dict(sess=sess, hbc=hbc, hour_bin=np.array(HOUR_ORDER, dtype=object)[hbc], net=net, stop=stop, dur=dur, today_net=tn, today_stops=ts,
                sess_run=sess_run, cell_run=cell_run, sess_first=sess_first, win=net > 0, fine=fine if fine is not None else hbc.astype(int))


def real_frame(T, rows, S, G):
    """The real IS units as a stream frame (the built ledger, asserted equal to the recomputed one by SS.session_frame)."""
    pre = "l1_" if T.label == "L1" else "fnd_"
    exit_ = T.F.iloc[rows][pre + "exit_i"].to_numpy().astype(int); dur = exit_ - T.setup_i[rows]
    hbc = np.array([HB_CODE[h] for h in S["hour_bin"]], dtype=np.int8)
    St = stream_frame(S["sess"], hbc, S["net"], S["stop"], dur, fine=G["fine_of_bar"][T.setup_i[rows]] if G else None)
    assert np.abs(St["today_net"] - S["today_net"]).max() < 1e-6 and (St["today_stops"] == S["today_stops"]).all()
    return St


def build_generator(T, tf, rows, S):
    F = T.F.iloc[rows]
    B = pd.read_parquet(os.path.join(H.DATA, tf, "bars.parquet"), columns=["i", "datetime", "session_idx"])
    bi = B.i.to_numpy(); assert (bi == np.arange(len(B))).all(), "bar index must be the row index"
    hhmm = B.datetime.astype(str).str[11:16].to_numpy()
    uniq = sorted(set(hhmm.tolist())); code_of = {h: HB_CODE[hbin(h)] for h in uniq}; fine_of = {h: fine_code(h) for h in uniq}
    bar_hbc = np.array([code_of[h] for h in hhmm], dtype=np.int8); fine_of_bar = np.array([fine_of[h] for h in hhmm], dtype=np.int16)
    setup = T.setup_i[rows]
    assert (bar_hbc[setup] == np.array([HB_CODE[h] for h in S["hour_bin"]])).all(), "hour_bin must be the build's clock, bar by bar"
    bs = B.session_idx.to_numpy()
    last_bar = pd.Series(bi).groupby(bs).last(); at1525 = hhmm == "15:25"
    cut = pd.Series(bi[at1525]).groupby(bs[at1525]).first().reindex(last_bar.index)
    cut = cut.fillna(last_bar).astype(int)
    exit_ = F.l1_exit_i.to_numpy().astype(int); dur = exit_ - setup; assert (dur >= 1).all()
    sess = S["sess"]; active = np.array(sorted(set(sess.tolist())))
    first = pd.Series(setup).groupby(sess).min().reindex(active).to_numpy().astype(int)
    nxt_same = np.r_[sess[1:] == sess[:-1], False]
    gaps = (np.r_[setup[1:], 0] - exit_)[nxt_same]; assert (gaps >= 1).all(), "the next SETUP always follows the exit"
    hbc = bar_hbc[setup]
    pools = [np.flatnonzero(hbc == c) for c in range(len(HOUR_ORDER))]
    return dict(tf=tf, bar_hbc=bar_hbc, fine_of_bar=fine_of_bar, cut=cut.reindex(active).to_numpy().astype(int), first=first, active=active,
                net=S["net"].astype(float), stop=S["stop"].astype(bool), dur=dur.astype(int), gaps=gaps.astype(int), pools=pools, n_real=int(len(rows)),
                pool_sizes=[int(len(p)) for p in pools], gap_median=float(np.median(gaps)), sessions_without_1525=int(cut.isna().sum()) if hasattr(cut, "isna") else 0)


def simulate(G, seed, tied=True):
    """One memoryless stream on the real session skeleton (see the docstring)."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    n_max = 8 * G["n_real"]; U = rng.random((3, n_max)); q = 0
    S_, Hc, J, Dd, Fi = [], [], [], [], []
    bar_hbc, pools, dur, gaps, fine_of_bar = G["bar_hbc"], G["pools"], G["dur"], G["gaps"], G["fine_of_bar"]
    ng = len(gaps)
    for s, t, c in zip(G["active"], G["first"], G["cut"]):
        t = int(t); c = int(c)
        while t < c:
            h = int(bar_hbc[t]); p = pools[h]
            if len(p) == 0: t += 1; continue
            if q >= n_max: raise RuntimeError("stream longer than 8x the real book")
            j = p[int(U[0, q] * len(p))]
            d = int(dur[j]) if tied else int(dur[p[int(U[1, q] * len(p))]])
            S_.append(s); Hc.append(h); J.append(j); Dd.append(d); Fi.append(int(fine_of_bar[t]))
            ex = min(t + max(d, 1), c)
            t = ex + int(gaps[int(U[2, q] * ng)])
            q += 1
    J = np.array(J, dtype=int)
    return stream_frame(np.array(S_, dtype=int), np.array(Hc, dtype=np.int8), G["net"][J], G["stop"][J], np.array(Dd, dtype=int), fine=np.array(Fi, dtype=np.int16))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the mechanism table (why N1 is mis-specified)
def mechanism(St):
    win, dur, stop, sess, cell, net = St["win"], St["dur"], St["stop"], St["sess"], St["cell_run"], St["net"]
    last_s = np.r_[sess[1:] != sess[:-1], True]
    cnt_c = np.bincount(cell); multi = cnt_c[cell] > 1
    last_c = np.r_[cell[1:] != cell[:-1], True]; first_c = np.r_[True, cell[1:] != cell[:-1]]
    cnt_s = np.bincount(St["sess_run"]); multi_s = cnt_s[St["sess_run"]] > 1
    m = lambda x: float(np.mean(x)) if len(x) else float("nan")
    return dict(units=int(len(win)), sessions=int(len(St["sess_first"])), win_rate=m(win), mean_net=m(net),
                bars_held_win_mean=m(dur[win]), bars_held_win_median=float(np.median(dur[win])) if win.any() else float("nan"),
                bars_held_loss_mean=m(dur[~win]), bars_held_loss_median=float(np.median(dur[~win])) if (~win).any() else float("nan"),
                bars_held_stop_mean=m(dur[stop]), p_follow_given_win=m(~last_s[win]), p_follow_given_loss=m(~last_s[~win]),
                cell_multi_units=int(multi.sum()), cell_multi_last_win_rate=m(win[multi & last_c]), cell_multi_nonlast_win_rate=m(win[multi & ~last_c]),
                cell_multi_first_win_rate=m(win[multi & first_c]), cell_multi_last_mean_net=m(net[multi & last_c]), cell_multi_nonlast_mean_net=m(net[multi & ~last_c]),
                sess_multi_last_win_rate=m(win[multi_s & last_s]), sess_multi_nonlast_win_rate=m(win[multi_s & ~last_s]))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- cells on any frame
def cell_keep(cfg, St, runmin):
    k, L = cfg["max_stops_today"], cfg["max_loss_today_inr"]
    if cfg.get("rearm_after_win"): m = SS.rearm_keep(St["net"], St["stop"], St["sess_first"], St["sess_run"], k, L)
    else: m = SS.grid_keep(St["today_stops"], runmin, k, L)
    if cfg.get("active_from_hour_bin") is not None: m = m | (St["hbc"] < HB_CODE[cfg["active_from_hour_bin"]])
    return m


def cell_stats(St, cells):
    runmin = SS.running_min_by_session(St["today_net"], St["sess_first"], St["sess_run"])
    pooled, strat, share = np.full(len(cells), np.nan), np.full(len(cells), np.nan), np.full(len(cells), np.nan)
    for i, c in enumerate(cells):
        m = cell_keep(c, St, runmin); share[i] = m.mean()
        if m.any() and (~m).any():
            pooled[i] = St["net"][m].mean() - St["net"][~m].mean(); strat[i] = strat_diff(St["hbc"], m, St["net"])
    return pooled, strat, share


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- N1 as in session_stop.null_test, on any frame, with an explicit rng
def n1_on_frame(St, rng, draws):
    cell = St["cell_run"]; obs = SS.stats7(St["today_net"], St["today_stops"], St["net"])
    perm_stats = np.empty((draws, 7))
    for d in range(draws):
        perm = np.lexsort((rng.random(len(cell)), cell))
        pn, ps = St["net"][perm], St["stop"][perm]
        tn, ts = SS.recompute_ledger(pn, ps, St["sess_first"], St["sess_run"])
        perm_stats[d] = SS.stats7(tn, ts, pn)
    p, lo, hi, pct, n = tail_p(obs, perm_stats)
    return dict(observed=obs, p=p, p_holm=holm(p), perm_mean=np.nanmean(perm_stats, axis=0), excess=obs - np.nanmean(perm_stats, axis=0))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- parallel jobs over memoryless streams
def sim_batch(G, seeds, tied, cells):
    out = []
    for sd in seeds:
        St = simulate(G, int(sd), tied)
        pooled, strat, share = cell_stats(St, cells)
        out.append(dict(seed=int(sd), n=int(len(St["net"])), sessions=int(len(St["sess_first"])), stats7=SS.stats7(St["today_net"], St["today_stops"], St["net"]),
                        strat7=strat7(St["hbc"], St["today_net"], St["today_stops"], St["net"]), strat7_fine=strat7(St["fine"], St["today_net"], St["today_stops"], St["net"]),
                        mech=mechanism(St), pooled=pooled, strat=strat, share=share))
    return out


def demo_batch(G, seeds, tied, tf, n1_draws, control_draws):
    out = []
    for sd in seeds:
        St = simulate(G, int(sd), tied)
        R = n1_on_frame(St, np.random.default_rng(int(sd) ^ 0x5bd1e995), n1_draws)
        runmin = SS.running_min_by_session(St["today_net"], St["sess_first"], St["sess_run"])
        m = SS.grid_keep(St["today_stops"], runmin, 2, None)

        rc = fz_report.random_control(raw, sel, control_draws, H.SEED, f"{STUDY}|repair|{tf}|demo|{'tied' if tied else 'indep'}|{int(sd)}")

        out.append(dict(seed=int(sd), tied=bool(tied), n=int(len(St["net"])), min_p_holm=float(np.nanmin(R["p_holm"])), rejected=bool(np.nanmin(R["p_holm"]) < CFG["alpha"]),
                        observed=R["observed"], excess=R["excess"], p_holm=R["p_holm"], k2_kept_share=float(m.mean()),
                        k2_pooled_diff=float(St["net"][m].mean() - St["net"][~m].mean()) if m.any() and (~m).any() else float("nan"),
                        k2_strat_diff=strat_diff(St["hbc"], m, St["net"]) if m.any() and (~m).any() else float("nan"),

                        cell_multi_last_win_rate=mech["cell_multi_last_win_rate"], cell_multi_nonlast_win_rate=mech["cell_multi_nonlast_win_rate"]))
    return out


def run_parallel(fn, G, seeds, per_task, *args):
    batches = [seeds[i:i + per_task] for i in range(0, len(seeds), per_task)]
    res = Parallel(n_jobs=CFG["n_jobs"], backend="loky")(delayed(fn)(G, b, *args) for b in batches)
    return [r for batch in res for r in batch]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- N4 on the real book
def session_units(St):
    S_ = np.array(sorted(set(St["sess"].tolist()))); return S_, [np.flatnonzero(St["sess"] == s) for s in S_]


def boot_rows(St, tag, draws):
    S_, units = session_units(St)
    idx = H.stationary_bootstrap_idx(len(S_), draws, tag=tag)
    return [np.concatenate([units[i] for i in idx[d]]) for d in range(draws)]


def n4_bootstrap(St, strata_key, tag, draws):
    strata = St[strata_key]
    obs = strat7(strata, St["today_net"], St["today_stops"], St["net"])
    boot = np.empty((draws, 7))
    for d, r in enumerate(boot_rows(St, tag, draws)):
        boot[d] = strat7(strata[r], St["today_net"][r], St["today_stops"][r], St["net"][r])
    p, lo, hi, pct, n = tail_p(np.zeros(7), boot)
    p = np.where(np.isfinite(obs), p, np.nan)
    q = lambda a: np.nanquantile(boot, a, axis=0)
    return dict(observed=obs, boot_mean=np.nanmean(boot, axis=0), boot_sd=np.nanstd(boot, axis=0), ci90=[q(0.05), q(0.95)], ci95=[q(0.025), q(0.975)],
                p=p, p_holm=holm(p), p_le0=lo, p_ge0=hi, n_valid=n, draws=draws, strata=int(strata.max()) + 1)


def n_condition(St):
    out = [len(St["net"])]
    for k in K_TESTS: out.append(int((St["today_stops"] >= k).sum()))
    for L in L_TESTS: out.append(int((St["today_net"] <= L).sum()))
    return out


def null_tables(St, sims, n4, n4_fine, tf, label):
    """The repaired null-test table for one (tf, label): N3 (simulation) and N4 (stratified bootstrap) per test."""
    obs7 = SS.stats7(St["today_net"], St["today_stops"], St["net"])
    sim7 = np.array([s["stats7"] for s in sims]); simS = np.array([s["strat7"] for s in sims]); simF = np.array([s["strat7_fine"] for s in sims])
    p3, lo3, hi3, pct3, n3 = tail_p(obs7, sim7); ph3 = holm(p3)
    p4s, _, _, pct4s, _ = tail_p(n4["observed"], simS)            # the N4 statistic against its memoryless distribution (centring check)
    p4f, _, _, pct4f, _ = tail_p(n4_fine["observed"], simF)
    ncond = n_condition(St)
    rows = []
    for j, t in enumerate(TESTS):
        rows.append(dict(tf=tf, label=label, test=t, n_condition=ncond[j], observed=round(float(obs7[j]), 4),
                         N3_sim_mean=round(float(np.nanmean(sim7[:, j])), 4), N3_sim_sd=round(float(np.nanstd(sim7[:, j])), 4), N3_excess=round(float(obs7[j] - np.nanmean(sim7[:, j])), 4),
                         N3_pct=round(float(pct3[j]), 2), N3_p=round(float(p3[j]), 4), N3_p_holm=round(float(ph3[j]), 4), N3_valid=int(n3[j]),
                         N4_stat=round(float(n4["observed"][j]), 4), N4_boot_sd=round(float(n4["boot_sd"][j]), 4), N4_ci90_lo=round(float(n4["ci90"][0][j]), 4), N4_ci90_hi=round(float(n4["ci90"][1][j]), 4),
                         N4_ci95_lo=round(float(n4["ci95"][0][j]), 4), N4_ci95_hi=round(float(n4["ci95"][1][j]), 4), N4_p=round(float(n4["p"][j]), 4), N4_p_holm=round(float(n4["p_holm"][j]), 4),
                         N4_sim_mean=round(float(np.nanmean(simS[:, j])), 4), N4_sim_sd=round(float(np.nanstd(simS[:, j])), 4), N4_sim_pct=round(float(pct4s[j]), 2), N4_sim_p=round(float(p4s[j]), 4),
                         N4fine_stat=round(float(n4_fine["observed"][j]), 4), N4fine_p=round(float(n4_fine["p"][j]), 4), N4fine_p_holm=round(float(n4_fine["p_holm"][j]), 4),
                         N4fine_sim_mean=round(float(np.nanmean(simF[:, j])), 4), N4fine_sim_p=round(float(p4f[j]), 4)))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows), dict(min_p_holm_N3=float(np.nanmin(ph3)), min_p_holm_N4=float(np.nanmin(n4["p_holm"])), rejected_N3=bool(np.nanmin(ph3) < CFG["alpha"]),
                                    rejected_N4=bool(np.nanmin(n4["p_holm"]) < CFG["alpha"]), min_p_holm_N4fine=float(np.nanmin(n4_fine["p_holm"])),
                                    signs_agree=bool(all(np.sign(obs7[j] - np.nanmean(sim7[:, j])) == np.sign(n4["observed"][j]) for j in range(7)
                                                         if ph3[j] < CFG["alpha"] and n4["p_holm"][j] < CFG["alpha"])))


def decide(d):
    if d["rejected_N3"] and d["rejected_N4"] and d["signs_agree"]: return "MEMORY CLAIMED: N3 and N4 both reject (Holm 5%) with agreeing signs -> session memory beyond the hour effect"
    if d["rejected_N3"] != d["rejected_N4"] or (d["rejected_N3"] and d["rejected_N4"]): return "INCONCLUSIVE: exactly one hindsight-free null rejects (or signs disagree) -> not shown, no key"
    return "NOT REJECTED under N3 or N4 -> no session memory shown beyond the hour effect, no key"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- branch B repair (the 48-cell family, hindsight-free judgement)
def choose_key(T, masks, tr):
    best = SS.choose_cell(T, masks, tr)
    return best[2] if best is not None else None


def branch_b_repair(T, tf, St, sims, out, dev):
    log(f"[{tf}] branch B repair: 16 hour-conditioned cells (active_from_hour_bin={ACTIVE_FROM}), nested / CPCV over the 48-cell family, hindsight-free judgement")
    is_rows = np.flatnonzero(T.is_mask)
    masks32 = SS.cell_masks(T)
    runmin = SS.running_min_by_session(St["today_net"], St["sess_first"], St["sess_run"])
    masks = {}
    for c in CELLS48:
        m = cell_keep(c, St, runmin); full = np.ones(T.n, dtype=bool); full[is_rows] = m; masks[key_of(c)] = full
    for c in CELLS48[:32]: assert (masks32[key_of(c)] == masks[key_of(c)]).all(), "the 32 as-run masks must reproduce"
    fam = f"{STUDY}/grid"
    led = {}
    for r in H.read_ledger(fam, tf=tf, label="L1"):
        if r["family"] == fam: led.setdefault(key_of(r["config"]), r)                    # the first (as-run) row per config
    grid_rows = []
    for c in CELLS48:
        k = key_of(c)
        if k in led: r = dict(led[k], source="ledger (as run)" if led[k].get("note") != "repair" else "ledger (repair)")
        elif dev: r = dict(H.metrics(T, masks[k], is_rows, tag="dev", controls=False), id="dev", config=c, source="dev (no ledger row)")
        else: r = dict(H.score(T, masks[k], fam, c, script=__file__, note="repair"), source="repair")
        grid_rows.append(r)
        log(f"  cell {c}: id {r['id']} kept {r['kept_n']} share {r['kept_share']} diff {r['diff']} top1off {r['diff_top1_removed']} ctrl {r.get('control_pct')} [{r['source']}]")
    # nested choice inside the 12 purged folds, the 66 CPCV splits -> 11 paths (criterion unchanged: max pooled diff | kept_share >= 0.20)
    oof = np.zeros(T.n, dtype=bool); chosen = []
    for b, (tr, te) in enumerate(H.purged_splits(T)):
        k = choose_key(T, masks, tr); chosen.append(json.loads(k) if k else None)
        oof[te] = masks[k][te] if k else True
    sel_cfg = dict(selection="max diff | kept_share>=0.20 in training fold", folds=12, cells=48, family="grid as run + active_from_hour_bin=13")
    nested = H.score(T, oof, f"{STUDY}/nested", sel_cfg, script=__file__, note="repair") if not dev else dict(H.metrics(T, oof, is_rows, tag="dev", controls=False), id="dev")

    paths = H.cpcv_paths(T, oof_split)

    log(f"[{tf}/L1] units {G['n_real']} active sessions {len(G['active'])} pools {out['generator']['pool_sizes']} gap median {G['gap_median']}")
    # mechanism (real)
    mech_real = mechanism(St); log(f"[{tf}/L1] mechanism (real): " + json.dumps({k: round(v, 4) if isinstance(v, float) else v for k, v in mech_real.items()}))
    # N3: 2,000 memoryless streams (tied duration)

                     sim_units_mean=float(np.mean([s["n"] for s in sims])), sim_units_sd=float(np.std([s["n"] for s in sims])), null_tests=tab.to_dict(orient="records"), **dec)

    drows = []

        for j, t in enumerate(TESTS): r[f"excess_{t}"] = round(float(d["excess"][j]), 4); r[f"p_holm_{t}"] = round(float(d["p_holm"][j]), 4)
        drows.append(r)
    dd = pd.DataFrame(drows); dd.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTDIR, f"repair_n1_memoryless_{tf}.csv"), index=False)
    summ = {}
    for name, g in dd.groupby("duration"):
        summ[name] = dict(streams=int(len(g)), n1_rejected_share=round(float(g.rejected.mean()), 4), min_p_holm_median=round(float(g.min_p_holm.median()), 4),
                          excess_threshold_tests_mean={t: round(float(g[f"excess_{t}"].mean()), 2) for t in TESTS[1:]}, excess_spearman_mean=round(float(g[f"excess_{TESTS[0]}"].mean()), 4),
                          excess_threshold_all_positive_share=round(float((g[[f"excess_{t}" for t in TESTS[1:]]] > 0).all(axis=1).mean()), 4),
                          k2_control_pct_median=round(float(g.k2_control_pct.median()), 1), k2_control_pct_le5_share=round(float((g.k2_control_pct <= 5).mean()), 4),
                          k2_pooled_diff_mean=round(float(g.k2_pooled_diff.mean()), 2), k2_strat_diff_mean=round(float(g.k2_strat_diff.mean()), 2),
                          cell_multi_last_win_rate_mean=round(float(g.cell_multi_last_win_rate.mean()), 4), cell_multi_nonlast_win_rate_mean=round(float(g.cell_multi_nonlast_win_rate.mean()), 4))
    log(f"[{tf}] N1 demonstration on memoryless streams in {time.time() - t1:.0f}s: " + json.dumps(summ))
    out["n1_demonstration"] = summ
    # branch B: re-judged on 1 min (its rows exist); on 5 min only if memory were claimed
    if tf == "minute" or dec["decision"].startswith("MEMORY CLAIMED"):
        branch_b_repair(T, tf, St, sims, out, dev)
    else:
        out["branch_b_repair"] = None; log(f"[{tf}] branch B not run (never ran as run; the repaired decision does not trigger it)")
    return out


def selftest():
    strata = np.array([0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1, 1]); cond = np.array([1, 1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0], dtype=bool); net = np.array([1.0, 3.0, 0.0, 2.0, 10.0, 4.0, 6.0, 5.0])
    # stratum 0: m_a 2, m_b 1, w = 2*2/4 = 1; stratum 1: m_a 10, m_b 5, w = 1*3/4 = 0.75 -> (1*1 + 0.75*5) / 1.75 = 2.7142857
    assert abs(strat_diff(strata, cond, net) - (1 + 3.75) / 1.75) < 1e-12
    # equals the OLS coefficient with stratum fixed effects
    X = np.column_stack([cond.astype(float), (strata == 0).astype(float), (strata == 1).astype(float)]); beta = np.linalg.lstsq(X, net, rcond=None)[0]
    assert abs(beta[0] - strat_diff(strata, cond, net)) < 1e-9
    assert np.isnan(strat_diff(np.array([0, 0, 1, 1]), np.array([1, 1, 1, 1], dtype=bool), np.arange(4.0)))
    p, lo, hi, pct, n = tail_p(np.array([0.0]), np.array([[-1.0], [1.0], [2.0]])); assert abs(p[0] - 1.0) < 1e-12 and abs(pct[0] - 100 / 3) < 1e-9
    p, *_ = tail_p(np.array([5.0]), np.array([[-1.0], [1.0], [2.0]])); assert abs(p[0] - 2 * (1 / 4)) < 1e-12
    assert np.allclose(holm([0.01, 0.04, 0.03]), [0.03, 0.06, 0.06]); assert np.isnan(holm([0.01, np.nan])[1]) and holm([0.01, np.nan])[0] == 0.01
    net_ = np.array([-1000.0, -2500.0, 3000.0, -1500.0, -1200.0, 500.0, -900.0]); stop_ = np.array([0, 1, 0, 1, 1, 0, 0], dtype=bool)
    St = stream_frame(np.array([0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1]), np.array([2, 2, 5, 6, 3, 6, 7], dtype=np.int8), net_, stop_, np.array([5, 3, 60, 4, 4, 40, 3]))
    assert np.allclose(St["today_net"], [0, -1000, -3500, -500, 0, -1200, -700]) and (St["today_stops"] == [0, 0, 1, 1, 0, 1, 1]).all()
    runmin = SS.running_min_by_session(St["today_net"], St["sess_first"], St["sess_run"])
    # hour-conditioned k = 1: the rule binds only from hour_bin "13" (code 6): position 2 (code 5, stopped) is kept, position 3 (code 6) skipped, 6 (code 7) skipped
    assert (cell_keep(dict(max_stops_today=1, max_loss_today_inr=None, rearm_after_win=False, active_from_hour_bin="13"), St, runmin) == [1, 1, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0]).all()
    assert (cell_keep(dict(max_stops_today=1, max_loss_today_inr=None, rearm_after_win=False), St, runmin) == SS.grid_keep(St["today_stops"], runmin, 1, None)).all()
    m = mechanism(St); assert m["p_follow_given_win"] == 0.5 and m["units"] == 7
    r = n1_on_frame(St, np.random.default_rng(0), 20); assert r["observed"].shape == (7,)
    print("selftest ok")

entries.name: Monitor
entries.description:
Start a background monitor that streams events from a long-running script. Each stdout line is an event — you keep working and notifications arrive in the chat. Events arrive on their own schedule and are not replies from the user, even if one lands while you're waiting for the user to answer a question.

Pick by how many notifications you need:
- **One** ("tell me when the server is ready / the build finishes") → use **Bash with `run_in_background`** and a command that exits when the condition is true, e.g. `until grep -q "Ready in" dev.log; do sleep 0.5; done`. You get a single completion notification when it exits.
- **One per occurrence, until the monitor expires (re-arm to continue)** ("tell me every time an ERROR line appears") → Monitor with an unbounded command (`tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, `while true`).
- **One per occurrence, until a known end** ("emit each CI step result, stop when the run completes") → Monitor with a command that emits lines and then exits.

Your script's stdout is the event stream. Each line becomes a notification. Exit ends the watch.

  # Each matching log line is an event
  tail -f /var/log/app.log | grep --line-buffered "ERROR"

  # Each file change is an event
  inotifywait -m --format '%e %f' /watched/dir

  # Poll GitHub for new PR comments and emit one line per new comment
  last=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
  while true; do
    now=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
    gh api "repos/owner/repo/issues/123/comments?since=$last" --jq '.[] | "\(.user.login): \(.body)"'
    last=$now; sleep 30
  done

  # Node script that emits events as they arrive (e.g. WebSocket listener)
  node watch-for-events.js

  # Per-occurrence with a natural end: emit each CI check as it lands, exit when the run completes
  prev=""
  while true; do
    s=$(gh pr checks 123 --json name,bucket)
    cur=$(jq -r '.[] | select(.bucket!="pending") | "\(.name): \(.bucket)"' <<<"$s" | sort)
    comm -13 <(echo "$prev") <(echo "$cur")
    prev=$cur
    jq -e 'all(.bucket!="pending")' <<<"$s" >/dev/null && break
    sleep 30
  done

**Don't use an unbounded command for a single notification.** `tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, and `while true` never exit on their own, so the monitor stays armed until timeout even after the event has fired. For "tell me when X is ready," use Bash `run_in_background` with an `until` loop instead (one notification, ends in seconds). Note that `tail -f log | grep -m 1 ...` does *not* fix this: if the log goes quiet after the match, `tail` never receives SIGPIPE and the pipeline hangs anyway.

**Script quality:**
- Every pipe stage must flush per line or matches sit in its buffer unseen: `grep` needs `--line-buffered`, `awk` needs `fflush()`. `head` cannot flush at all — `| head -N` delivers nothing until N matches accumulate, then ends the stream.
- In poll loops, handle transient failures (`curl ... || true`) — one failed request shouldn't kill the monitor.
- Poll intervals: 30s+ for remote APIs (rate limits), 0.5-1s for local checks.
- Write a specific `description` — it appears in every notification ("errors in deploy.log" not "watching logs").
- Only stdout is the event stream. Stderr goes to the output file (readable via Read) but does not trigger notifications — for a command you run directly (e.g. `python train.py 2>&1 | grep --line-buffered ...`), merge stderr with `2>&1` so its failures reach your filter. (No effect on `tail -f` of an existing log — that file only contains what its writer redirected.)

**Coverage — silence is not success.** When watching a job or process for an outcome, your filter must match every terminal state, not just the happy path. A monitor that greps only for the success marker stays silent through a crashloop, a hung process, or an unexpected exit — and silence looks identical to "still running." Before arming, ask: *if this process crashed right now, would my filter emit anything?* If not, widen it.

  # Wrong — silent on crash, hang, or any non-success exit
  tail -f run.log | grep --line-buffered "elapsed_steps="

  # Right — one alternation covering progress + the failure signatures you'd act on
  tail -f run.log | grep -E --line-buffered "elapsed_steps=|Traceback|Error|FAILED|assert|Killed|OOM"

For poll loops checking job state, emit on every terminal status (`succeeded|failed|cancelled|timeout`), not just success. If you cannot confidently enumerate the failure signatures, broaden the grep alternation rather than narrow it — some extra noise is better than missing a crashloop.

**Output volume**: Every stdout line is a conversation message, so the filter should be selective — but selective means "the lines you'd act on," not "only good news." Never pipe raw logs; filter to exactly the success and failure signals you care about. Monitors that produce too many events are automatically stopped; restart with a tighter filter if this happens.

Stdout lines within 200ms are batched into a single notification, so multiline output from a single event groups naturally.

The script runs in the same shell environment as Bash. Exit ends the watch (exit code is reported). Every monitor expires after `timeout_ms` (default 5 minutes, at most 30 minutes): it is killed and you get one notice with the event count. Re-arm it if you still need the watch; for a long watch (PR monitoring, log tails) set `timeout_ms` to the maximum and re-arm on each expiry, and widen the filter if an expiry with no events was unexpected. Use TaskStop to cancel early.
**ws source** — open a WebSocket and stream each incoming text frame as an event. No shell, no polling: the server pushes, you get notified.

  Monitor({
    ws: {url: 'wss://events.example.com/stream', protocols: ['v1']},
    description: 'deploy events',
  })

Each text frame becomes one notification (multiline frames stay as one event). Binary frames are reported as `[binary frame, N bytes]` rather than passed through. Socket close ends the watch with the close code surfaced; errors are surfaced before close. Same rate limiting as bash — a firehose will be suppressed and eventually stopped, so subscribe to a filtered feed where one exists.

Prefer this over `command: 'websocat wss://…'` — it avoids the extra process and line-buffering pitfalls. Use bash when you need to transform or filter frames with shell tools before they become events.

description.description: Short human-readable description of what you are monitoring (shown in notifications).

timeout_ms.description: Kill the monitor after this deadline. Default 300000ms. Deadlines above 1800000ms are capped to 1800000ms. You are notified at expiry and can re-arm.

command.description: Shell command or script. Each stdout line is an event; exit ends the watch.

ws.description: WebSocket to open. Each text frame is an event; binary frames are reported as a placeholder line. Socket close ends the watch. Cannot be combined with command.

"""Build FINDINGS.md (tables + reading) and findings.json from results.json (the as-run study, session_stop.py) and
results_repair.json (the repair round, session_stop_repair.py): no number is typed by hand; every one is read from the two
results files (which carry the ledger ids) or the CSVs next to them.

    python write_findings.py
"""
import os, sys, json, hashlib, ast, math
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
import pandas as pd

R = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "results.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
REP = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "results_repair.json"), encoding="utf-8"))
PRE = R["preregistration"]; PRE_R = REP["preregistration"]
DOC = ast.get_docstring(ast.parse(open(os.path.join(HERE, "session_stop.py"), encoding="utf-8").read()))
DOC_R = ast.get_docstring(ast.parse(open(os.path.join(HERE, "session_stop_repair.py"), encoding="utf-8").read()))
PRE_SHA = hashlib.sha256(open(os.path.join(HERE, "preregistration.json"), "rb").read()).hexdigest()[:16]
PRE_R_SHA = hashlib.sha256(open(os.path.join(HERE, "preregistration_repair.json"), "rb").read()).hexdigest()[:16]
LOG = open(os.path.join(HERE, "session_stop.log"), encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines()
LEDGER_BEFORE = next((l.split("ledger sha before ")[1].strip() for l in LOG if "ledger sha before" in l), None)
ORIGINAL_SCRIPT_SHA = "6645343d4dfba103"          # the as-run session_stop.py (every as-run ledger row carries it); the file since holds a docstring-only repair note
TESTS = PRE["tests"]


def f(x, d=2):
    if x is None or (isinstance(x, float) and x != x): return ""
    if isinstance(x, bool): return str(x)
    if isinstance(x, int): return f"{x:,}"
    if isinstance(x, float): return f"{x:,.{d}f}"
    return str(x)


def md_table(df, cols=None, digits=None):
    cols = cols or list(df.columns); digits = digits or {}
    lines = ["| " + " | ".join(cols) + " |", "|" + "---|" * len(cols)]
    for _, r in df.iterrows():
        lines.append("| " + " | ".join(r[c] if isinstance(r[c], str) else f(r[c], digits.get(c, 2)) for c in cols) + " |")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def null_block(rec):
    t = pd.DataFrame(rec["tests"])
    cols = ["test", "n_condition", "n_other", "observed", "N1_perm_mean", "N1_perm_sd", "N1_excess", "N1_p", "N1_p_holm", "N2_perm_mean", "N2_excess", "N2_p", "N2_p_holm", "N1_p_abs_ref"]
    for c in cols[3:]: t[c] = t[c].astype(float)
    dg = {c: 4 for c in cols}; dg.update(n_condition=0, n_other=0)
    t["n_other"] = t["n_other"].astype(float)
    s = md_table(t, cols, dg)
    n1, n2 = rec["nulls"]["session_x_hour"], rec["nulls"]["session"]
    s += (f"\n\nN1 cells (session x hour_bin): {n1['n_cells']:,}, singletons {n1['cells_size1']:,}; rows that can move {n1['rows_movable']:,} of {rec['units']:,}. "
          f"N2 cells (sessions): {n2['n_cells']:,}, singletons {n2['cells_size1']:,}; rows that can move {n2['rows_movable']:,}. "
          f"Min Holm p: N1 {rec['min_p_holm_N1']:.4f}, N2 {rec['min_p_holm_N2']:.4f}; rejected at 5%: N1 {rec['rejected_N1']}, N2 {rec['rejected_N2']} "
          "(**as run; superseded by section R: N1's rejection is reproduced by a memoryless process**).")
    return s


def excess_signs(rec):
    ex = {t["test"]: t["N1_excess"] for t in rec["tests"]}
    thr = [v for k, v in ex.items() if k != "spearman_today_net"]
    return ex, all(v > 0 for v in thr), ex["spearman_today_net"]


def repaired_null_block(tf):
    X = REP["timeframes"][tf]["L1"]; t = pd.DataFrame(X["null_tests"])
    cols = ["test", "n_condition", "observed", "N3_sim_mean", "N3_sim_sd", "N3_excess", "N3_pct", "N3_p", "N3_p_holm", "N4_stat", "N4_boot_sd", "N4_ci90_lo", "N4_ci90_hi", "N4_p", "N4_p_holm", "N4_sim_mean", "N4_sim_p", "N4fine_stat", "N4fine_p_holm"]
    dg = {c: 4 for c in cols}; dg.update(n_condition=0, N3_pct=1)
    return md_table(t, cols, dg)


def L0_block(tf):
    X = REP["timeframes"][tf]["L0_robustness"]; t = pd.DataFrame(X["tests"])
    cols = ["test", "n_condition", "N4_stat", "N4_ci90_lo", "N4_ci90_hi", "N4_p", "N4_p_holm"]
    return md_table(t, cols, {c: 4 for c in cols} | dict(n_condition=0)) + f"\n\nL0 ({X['units']:,} IS units): min Holm p under N4 {X['min_p_holm_N4']:.4f}; rejected at 5%: {X['rejected_N4']}."


def mech_block(tf):
    X = REP["timeframes"][tf]["L1"]
    keys = list(X["mechanism_real"])
    t = pd.DataFrame(dict(metric=keys, real=[X["mechanism_real"][k] for k in keys], memoryless_tied_duration=[X["mechanism_memoryless_mean"][k] for k in keys],
                          memoryless_independent_duration=[X["mechanism_indep_mean"][k] for k in keys]))
    return md_table(t, list(t.columns), dict(real=4, memoryless_tied_duration=4, memoryless_independent_duration=4))


def demo_block(tf):
    Dm = REP["timeframes"][tf]["n1_demonstration"]; rows = []
    for name in ("tied to outcome", "independent of outcome"):
        d = Dm[name]
        rows.append(dict(duration=name, streams=d["streams"], N1_rejected_share=d["n1_rejected_share"], min_holm_p_median=d["min_p_holm_median"],
                         excess_all_threshold_tests_positive_share=d["excess_threshold_all_positive_share"], excess_spearman_mean=d["excess_spearman_mean"],
                         **{f"excess_{k}": v for k, v in d["excess_threshold_tests_mean"].items()},
                         k2_control_pct_median=d["k2_control_pct_median"], k2_control_pct_le5_share=d["k2_control_pct_le5_share"], k2_pooled_diff_mean=d["k2_pooled_diff_mean"],
                         k2_strat_diff_mean=d["k2_strat_diff_mean"], cell_last_win_rate=d["cell_multi_last_win_rate_mean"], cell_nonlast_win_rate=d["cell_multi_nonlast_win_rate_mean"]))
    t = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    return md_table(t, list(t.columns), dict(streams=0, N1_rejected_share=3, min_holm_p_median=4, excess_all_threshold_tests_positive_share=3, excess_spearman_mean=4,
                                              k2_control_pct_median=1, k2_control_pct_le5_share=3, cell_last_win_rate=4, cell_nonlast_win_rate=4))


def grid_table(rows, ids=True):
    g = pd.DataFrame([dict(k=r["config"]["max_stops_today"], L=("none" if r["config"]["max_loss_today_inr"] is None else f"{r['config']['max_loss_today_inr']:,.0f}"),
                           rearm=str(r["config"]["rearm_after_win"]), hours=("all day" if r["config"].get("active_from_hour_bin") is None else f">= {r['config']['active_from_hour_bin']}"),
                           id=r["id"], kept_n=r["kept_n"], share=r["kept_share"], kept_mean=r["kept_mean"], skipped_mean=r["skipped_mean"], diff=r["diff"], diff_top1_off=r["diff_top1_removed"],
                           control_pct_not_used=r["control_pct"], perm_p=r["perm_p"], loser_recall=r["loser_recall"], loser_prec=r["loser_precision"], w_recall=r["winner_recall_weighted"],
                           top10_skip=r["top_decile_winners_skipped"], sign_blocks=r["sign_blocks"], slip8=r["kept_mean_slip8"]) for r in rows])
    return md_table(g, list(g.columns), dict(k=0, kept_n=0, share=4, perm_p=4, control_pct_not_used=1, loser_recall=4, loser_prec=4, w_recall=4, top10_skip=4, sign_blocks=0))


def calibration_table(cal):
    c = pd.DataFrame(cal)
    c["L"] = c.max_loss_today_inr.map(lambda v: "none" if v is None or (isinstance(v, float) and v != v) else f"{v:,.0f}")
    c["hours"] = c.active_from_hour_bin.map(lambda v: "all day" if v is None or (isinstance(v, float) and v != v) else f">= {v}")
    c["rearm"] = c.rearm_after_win.astype(str)
    cols = ["max_stops_today", "L", "rearm", "hours", "ledger_id", "kept_share", "pooled_diff", "sim_pooled_mean", "sim_pooled_sd", "pooled_sim_pct", "pooled_sim_p", "strat_diff", "strat_ci90_lo", "strat_ci90_hi", "strat_boot_p",
            "sim_strat_mean", "strat_sim_pct", "diff_top1_removed", "sign_blocks", "control_pct"]
    c = c.rename(columns={"control_pct": "control_pct_not_used"}); cols[-1] = "control_pct_not_used"
    return md_table(c, cols, dict(max_stops_today=0, kept_share=4, pooled_sim_pct=1, pooled_sim_p=4, strat_boot_p=4, strat_sim_pct=1, sign_blocks=0, control_pct_not_used=1))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- as-run sections (kept as the record, re-read)
def sec_tf(tf):

def f(x, d=2):
    if x is None or (isinstance(x, float) and x != x): return ""

    if isinstance(x, float): return f"{x:,.{d}f}"
    return str(x)


def md_table(df, cols=None, digits=None):
    cols = cols or list(df.columns); digits = digits or {}
    lines = ["| " + " | ".join(cols) + " |", "|" + "---|" * len(cols)]
    for _, r in df.iterrows():
        lines.append("| " + " | ".join(r[c] if isinstance(r[c], str) else f(r[c], digits.get(c, 2)) for c in cols) + " |")
    return "\n".join(lines)


def null_block(rec):
    t = pd.DataFrame(rec["tests"])

    for c in cols[3:]: t[c] = t[c].astype(float)
    dg = {c: 4 for c in cols}; dg.update(n_condition=0, n_other=0)
    t["n_other"] = t["n_other"].astype(float)
    s = md_table(t, cols, dg)
    n1, n2 = rec["nulls"]["session_x_hour"], rec["nulls"]["session"]
    s += (f"\n\nN1 cells (session x hour_bin): {n1['n_cells']:,}, singletons {n1['cells_size1']:,}; rows that can move {n1['rows_movable']:,} of {rec['units']:,}. "
          f"N2 cells (sessions): {n2['n_cells']:,}, singletons {n2['cells_size1']:,}; rows that can move {n2['rows_movable']:,}. "
          f"Min Holm p: N1 {rec['min_p_holm_N1']:.4f}, N2 {rec['min_p_holm_N2']:.4f}; rejected at 5%: N1 {rec['rejected_N1']}, N2 {rec['rejected_N2']} "
          "(**as run; superseded by section R: N1's rejection is reproduced by a memoryless process**).")

                                              k2_control_pct_median=1, k2_control_pct_le5_share=3, cell_last_win_rate=4, cell_nonlast_win_rate=4))

def sec_tf(tf):

content.content:
## 0. Result in one paragraph

**No session memory beyond the hour effect is shown, and no `session_stop` key is proposed for ST13/ST14.** The as-run pre-registered null N1 (outcomes permuted within session x hour_bin cells over fixed positions) was rejected on 1 min (all seven tests, Holm p <= 0.0140) with a positive excess of +53 to +106 INR/trade, which the as-run study read as mean-reverting session memory. **That rejection is an artifact** (section R.1): the SETUP positions are generated by the outcomes (a trade runs until exit, winners hold ~6x longer than losers), and a memoryless generator that keeps only the clock and the durations reproduces the rejection on 0% of its streams (excess +74 to +123; 0% when the duration is made independent of the outcome). Two hindsight-free nulls replace it (section R.2): the within-hour contrast across sessions with a session-block bootstrap (N4) and the observed statistics against 2,000 memoryless streams (N3); on 1 min the min Holm p is N4 1.0000 / N3 1.0000, on 5 min N4 0.4158 / N3 0.2295: **NOT REJECTED under N3 or N4** on both timeframes (5 min underpowered as well). Branch B's grid (run under the as-run rejection) is re-judged on hindsight-free statistics only, wi

### R.1 Issue I1: why N1 cannot test session memory, and the memoryless demonstration

**Mechanism (real IS units vs the memoryless generator).** The generator (definitions in section 1b) keeps the real session skeleton and the clock, draws every outcome iid from the hour bin's pool, and lets the drawn unit's own duration decide when the next SETUP can occur (variant: a duration independent of the outcome). `cell_multi_*` = units in session x hour_bin cells with > 1 member (the only rows N1 can move); `last` / `nonlast` / `first` by position in the cell; `p_follow_given_*` = another unit follows in the session. Files `repair_mechanism_minute.csv`, `repair_mechanism_5minute.csv`. Memoryless columns are means over 60 (tied) and 200 (independent) streams.

**1 min**

| cell_multi_last_mean_net | -594.6968 | -526.1133 | -1,023.6224 |
| cell_multi_nonlast_mean_net | -1,828.3440 | -1,775.9653 | -1,022.7271 |
| sess_multi_last_win_rate | 0.4763 | 0.3656 | 0.1338 |
| sess_multi_nonlast_win_rate | 0.1022 | 0.1209 | 0.1568 |

**5 min**

| metric | real | memoryless_tied_duration | memoryless_independent_duration |
|---|---|---|---|

Reading (1 min): N1 rejects on 0% of the memoryless streams with the duration tied to the outcome (median min Holm p 0.1386), with a positive excess on every threshold test in 100% of them (means +74 to +123 INR/trade; the as-run study's real excess was +53 to +106) and a Spearman excess of -0.0237 (real -0.0233). With the duration independent of the outcome N1 rejects on 0% of the streams and the excess is -15 to +4. The as-run rejection is therefore the duration mechanism, not memory; **the statements "session memory beyond the hour effect", "mean-reverting" and the "reverse rule" follow-up are withdrawn** (they stay in the record above as withdrawn).

### R.2 The hindsight-free re-test: N3 (memoryless simulation) and N4 (within-hour contrast, session-block bootstrap)


Reading (1 min): every observed statistic sits inside the memoryless distribution (N3 percentiles spearman_today_net 45%, stops>=1 45%, stops>=2 22%, stops>=3 67%, net<=-2000 48%, net<=-4000 57%, net<=-6000 53%); every within-hour contrast's 90 % bootstrap CI covers zero and the memoryless centring check holds (|N4_sim_mean| small against the bootstrap sd). The within-hour differences of the as-run `hour_x_stops` table (positive in the morning, negative in the afternoon) are within sampling noise once sessions are the resampling unit. 5 min: the same, on a book that is underpowered by construction (median 2 SETUPs per active session).

### R.3 Issue I2: the session-matched random control is not evidence for a within-session sequential rule

On the memoryless streams (no edge and no anti-edge possible by construction) the k = 2 / L = none absorbing rule sits at a session-matched control percentile with median 0.0 (share of streams at or below the 5th percentile 1.00) when the duration is tied to the outcome, and median 0.0 (share <= 5: 1.00) when it is independent (table R.1; the real rule's value is 0.0 for all 32 as-run cells and for the 16 hour-conditioned cells below). The control draws n_s of the N_s realized positions; N_s is only known at session end and the last positions are long winners by construction, so a rule that keeps the earliest positions loses to it whatever its merit. **`control_pct` is reported in every table but is not used as evidence for or against any cell; `harness.go_no_go` is shown as computed and without its `control_pct>=95` check.** Flag for the orchestrator: the go/no-go control check is uninformative for any sequential (position-order) rule; a comparator for such rules must be causal (a random stopping rule with the same per-session stop counts, or the memoryless generator used here).

### R.4 Issue I3: the hour-conditioned cells and the 48-cell family (1 min; family `session_stop/grid`, 16 new ledger rows, `grid_hour_minute.csv`)

Rule: as the absorbing grid, active only from hour_bin `13` on (every SETUP before it is taken; `active_from_hour_bin` is the one data-informed choice of the repair, the sign change of the as-run within-hour table, and is counted as a trial). Columns as in section 4; `control_pct_not_used` reported only.

content.description: fz_v3/out/harness.py: the single evaluator.
